But a cheap price on a business with no moat is the old cigar-butt trap. The products are made by others, customers can buy them almost anywhere, and I see no pricing power or switching cost here. The snapshot also assumes zero growth, and it doesn't give me ten years of earnings history, CEO tenure, or ROIC, so I can't confirm the consistency I demand. Rule No. 1 says to pass, and I will wait for a wonderful business at a fair price.
